name: Default
shortDescription: Open-source form builder with a Nuxt frontend, Laravel API, queue worker and scheduler, backed by PostgreSQL and Redis.

alerts.message: Open the app right after deploy: the first visit runs the setup page that creates the admin account. Emails are only written to the logs until you set MAIL_MAILER to smtp and fill in the MAIL_* variables.
Self-hosted instances without an Enterprise license are limited to 2 users in total.
